purpose: Scripted HCI peer sim: connect, LE Secure Connections pair, GATT CCCD + app-auth write, 32 MiB NOR compare vs stock and vs post-boot NOR.
method: Single-temple match-style resc (CHIPREV 0x22, same NOR/ITCM fixtures as paired-boot-smp) plus LoadPeerFixture/LoadPeerSignalFixture/LoadLinkEncryptionFixture/LoadPeerDataLengthFixture before the 8s boot. After boot: ConnectPeer 24/0/500, ATT MTU 247, g2emu.ble_smp.pair_renode_link (deterministic SecureConnectionsCentral label g2-blestore-hci-peer), CCCD write 1245080100 to handle 0x0845, ATT Write Command 0x52 to handle 0x0842 with AA21 SID 0x80 auth protobuf 080410641a0408011004. Imports emulator g2emu only; emulator repo not modified. OpenCFW boot emits already-accepted unmodeled nPM1300 TIMER [ERROR] lines (same as blestore-1926-match.log); the script tolerates only those two messages because RenodeConsole treats any [ERROR] as a failed command.

stock.mtu: firmware ATT MTU req 02f700, central rsp 03f700
stock.pair: complete; DHKey checks verified; controller AES-CCM authenticated; 9 identical SMP PDUs

opencfw-1926.mtu: firmware ATT MTU req 02f700, central rsp 03f700
opencfw-1926.pair: complete; DHKey checks verified; controller AES-CCM authenticated; 9 SMP PDUs byte-identical to stock

nor.vs_post_boot_match_nor: bit-identical (same sha256 4049ca4e899c7d069573bc4ca86e57c8b00f4b6564de5f2f8e9c9f983610758e as blestore-1926-match.nor.bin / stock-match.nor.bin). Pairing did not persist a bond record to NOR in this short still-connected session.

differences_not_treated_as_c_mismatches.what: During the pairing window stock also emitted ATT Read By Group Type 060100ffff00280118 (cid 4); OpenCFW did not in that window. All 9 cid-6 SMP PDUs (Pairing Req/Rsp, both public keys, Confirm, both Random, both DHKey Check) are byte-identical, including the firmware public key.

App-auth AA12 sequence numbers differ (stock 43 then 143, OpenCFW 60 then 160). The required ack payload 080410641a00 matches. A follow-up SID 0x80 flag-1 notification payload differs in one protobuf varint (stock 0804108f011a020801 vs OpenCFW 080410a0011a020801). Not a failed auth.
differences_not_treated_as_c_mismatches.kind: AA frame counters / secondary notification field

differences_not_treated_as_c_mismatches.what: OpenCFW 8s boot logs unmodeled nPM1300 TIMER [ERROR] (ship mode with watchdog active / kick while stopped), already present in the accepted full-1926 match log; stock does not. Tolerated in the peer script only for those two messages.
differences_not_treated_as_c_mismatches.kind: emulator PMIC model gap, previously accepted

notes: Stock skipped on the successful OpenCFW resume; stock run was 20:25-20:26 America/Chicago, OpenCFW 20:27 America/Chicago.
emulator repo, sources.json, and opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin were not modified.
Next: keep the link up longer or disconnect/bond-store and re-diff NOR for an actual bond-record persistence check.
